title: ADR-03 Gateway, action classes R/C/I1/I2/U, policy and epoch fencing
outcome: The single mediated path: per-instance classification R/C/I1/I2/U (U denied, fail-closed), policy incl. early hold on sensitive-tagged fields, outbox for I-class, epoch + deny-list checked inside the write txn; due 24 Nov
acceptance: ADR file ≤900 words with sections Context, Decision, Consequences, Interface touched (which of C1–C6), Tests that prove it
Classification is per action instance, unknown → U → deny; every denial is a recorded action
Epoch and deny-list checked inside the execution transaction, holds re-checked at outbox dispatch; early hold is a generic rule on sensitive-tagged fields, not IBAN code
Tests listed map to RT1 (DB bypass → reconcile U-alert), RT5 (TOCTOU: 0 culprit writes after quarantine seq)
